provider normalization, including the Gemini fenced-JSON fix
content sufficiency of the v2 pool/pair protocol on the exact query that failed in canary v1

canary_scope_note: CANARY V2 -- INSTRUMENTATION AND CONTENT-SUFFICIENCY VALIDATION ONLY. Reuses the exact same scidocs query as counterfactual_collector_canary_v1 (whose pool was 10/10 title-only under the v1 pool protocol, causing all three parseable providers to abstain and Gemini to hit a parse_failure), but builds its pool under lexical_prior_pool_v2 instead. Purpose: verify the v2 document-validity gate and bounded-denominator prior produce a pool with substantive content for this specific previously-failing query, and verify the Gemini fenced-JSON normalization fix, with a minimal number of live calls. One selected pair, one presentation orientation, zero reserve budget -- it lacks the complete frozen presentation and repeat protocol of the micro-pilot. Canary results MUST NOT be merged into counterfactual_micro_pilot_v2 benchmark data. Do not execute this configuration without explicit, separate authorization.

scidocs.selection_note: Same frozen SciDocs query id as counterfactual_collector_canary_v1 (reused, not re-derived), chosen specifically because it is the query whose v1 pool was 100% title-only.

candidate_pool.pool_protocol_note: Same qrels-blind bounded-denominator lexical prior plus document-validity gate as counterfactual_micro_pilot_v2.
candidate_pool.rendering_policy_note: Same deterministic title+prefix-truncation rendering policy as counterfactual_micro_pilot_v2 (unchanged from v1).

acquisition.adaptive_repeat_triggers_note: None: reserved_followup_calls is 0, so no reserve round runs regardless of outcome.

call_budget.formula_note: 1 query x 4 providers x 1 pair = 4 initial calls; no reserve.
call_budget.max_retries_note: No retries are attempted by the collector once a call has been sent. A call that fails before any provider call is attempted (for example, a missing-credentials preflight failure, which never reaches the network) may safely be re-run after fixing the environment, since nothing was billed -- but this is a manual operator decision, not an automatic collector retry.
